questions.title: Growing cube
questions.prompt: The volume of a cube increases at $30\text{ cm}^3$/s. Find the rate of increase of its surface area when the edge is $10$ cm.

questions.title: Carbon dating
questions.prompt: Carbon-14 decays with half-life $5730$ years. A fossil has $30\%$ of its original carbon-14. Estimate its age to the nearest $10$ years.

questions.title: Heating in an oven
questions.prompt: A tray at $20^\circ$C is placed in an oven at $250^\circ$C, and $\dfrac{dT}{dt}=k(250-T)$. After $10$ minutes it is at $120^\circ$C. Find its temperature after $20$ minutes, to one decimal place.
hints: You do not need k itself.

ladder.method: You do not need k itself.

questions.title: Chain rule with time
questions.prompt: A point moves along $y=x^{3}-2x$ so that $x$ increases at $3$ units per second. Find the rate of change of $y$ when $x=2$.

questions.title: Melting ice cube
questions.prompt: An ice cube melts so that its volume decreases at $6\text{ cm}^3$/min while it stays cube-shaped. Find the rate of change of its surface area when the edge is $2$ cm.

questions.title: Warming a cold drink
questions.prompt: A drink at $10^\circ$C is placed in a room at $25^\circ$C, so that $T=25-15e^{-kt}$. After $4$ minutes it is at $15^\circ$C. Find the rate at which its temperature is rising at that moment, to two decimal places.

questions.title: Inflating sphere, volume rate
questions.prompt: The radius of a sphere increases at $0.5$ cm/s. Find the rate of increase of its volume when $r=10$ cm.

questions.title: Growing square
questions.prompt: The side of a square increases at $3$ cm/s. How fast is the area increasing when the side is $7$ cm?

questions.title: Moving round a circle
questions.prompt: A point moves on $x^{2}+y^{2}=25$. At $(3,4)$, $\dfrac{dx}{dt}=2$. Find $\dfrac{dy}{dt}$ there.

questions.title: Cooling towards room temperature
questions.prompt: An object cools according to $T=20+Ae^{-kt}$. It starts at $100^\circ$C and is at $60^\circ$C after $10$ minutes. Find its temperature after $20$ minutes.

traps.why: Assumed it cools linearly by 40 each 10 minutes.

questions.title: Expanding equilateral triangle
questions.prompt: The side of an equilateral triangle increases at $2$ cm/s. Find the rate of increase of its area when the side is $6$ cm.

questions.title: Filling a cylinder
questions.prompt: Water flows at $3\text{ m}^3$/min into a cylindrical tank of radius $2$ m. Find the rate at which the depth rises.

questions.title: Angle of a sliding ladder
questions.prompt: A $10$ m ladder slides so that its foot moves away from the wall at $1$ m/s. Find the rate of change of the angle $\theta$ between the ladder and the ground when the foot is $6$ m from the wall.

questions.title: Down to ten percent
questions.prompt: A substance halves every $8$ hours. How long until only $10\%$ remains? Give two decimal places.

traps.why: Assumed it loses 12.5% of the original each 8 hours.

questions.title: Tripling time
questions.prompt: A quantity satisfies $\dfrac{dy}{dt}=ky$ and doubles every $5$ years. Find how long it takes to triple, to two decimal places.
hints: Use the doubling time for k.

ladder.method: Use the doubling time for k.

questions.title: Shrinking sphere, surface area rate
questions.prompt: The volume of a sphere decreases at $8\text{ cm}^3$/s. Find the rate of change of its surface area when $r=4$ cm.

questions.title: Distance from the origin along a parabola
questions.prompt: A point moves along $y=x^{2}$ with $x$ increasing at $2$ units/s. Find the rate at which its distance from the origin is increasing when $x=1$.

questions.title: Population approaching a floor
questions.prompt: A population satisfies $P=200+Ae^{kt}$. Initially $P=1000$ and after $2$ years $P=600$. Find $P$ after $6$ years.

questions.title: Filling a cone
questions.prompt: Water is poured at $5\text{ cm}^3$/s into an inverted cone whose radius is half its height. Find the rate at which the depth rises when the depth is $4$ cm.

questions.title: Angle of elevation to a plane
questions.prompt: A plane flies at a constant height of $3$ km towards an observer at $300$ km/h. Find the rate at which the angle of elevation is increasing when the horizontal distance is $4$ km.

questions.title: Half-life from two readings
questions.prompt: A sample decays exponentially from $50$ g to $40$ g in $3$ days. Find its half-life, to two decimal places.

traps.why: Assumed a linear loss of 10 g each 3 days.

questions.title: Tripling in four years
questions.prompt: A quantity grows as $P=P_0e^{kt}$ and triples every $4$ years. Find the exact value of $k$.

questions.title: When the drug level falls below two
questions.prompt: The concentration of a drug is $C=10e^{-0.2t}$ mg/L after $t$ hours. When does it first fall below $2$ mg/L? Give two decimal places.

questions.title: A cylinder of fixed volume
questions.prompt: A cylinder keeps a volume of $100\text{ cm}^3$ while its radius increases at $0.1$ cm/s. Find the rate of change of its height when $r=5$ cm.

questions.title: Volume rate of a growing cube
questions.prompt: The edge of a cube increases at $0.2$ cm/s. Find the rate of increase of volume when the edge is $5$ cm.

questions.title: Radius rate from a volume rate
questions.prompt: The volume of a sphere increases at $36\pi\text{ cm}^3$/s. Find the rate of increase of the radius when $r=3$ cm.

questions.title: Spreading oil slick
questions.prompt: The area of a circular oil slick increases at $50\text{ m}^2$/s. Find the rate of increase of its radius when $r=10$ m.

questions.title: Cooling from ninety to thirty
questions.prompt: An object cools according to $T=20+70e^{-0.1t}$. Find when it reaches $30^\circ$C, to two decimal places.

questions.title: Carbon after a thousand years
questions.prompt: Carbon-14 has half-life $5730$ years. What fraction of a sample remains after $1000$ years, to four decimal places?

questions.title: Two cars from a crossing
questions.prompt: Two cars leave an intersection at the same time, one north at $40$ km/h and one east at $30$ km/h. Show that the distance between them increases at a constant rate, and find that rate.
hints: Write both distances at time t.

ladder.nudge: Write both distances at time t.

questions.title: Point on a root curve
questions.prompt: A point moves along $y=\sqrt x$ with $x$ increasing at $4$ units/s. Find the rate of change of $y$ when $x=4$.

questions.title: Area rate of a widening circle
questions.prompt: The radius of a circle increases at $3$ cm/s. Find the rate of increase of area when $r=4$ cm.

questions.title: Ladder of thirteen metres
questions.prompt: A $13$ m ladder slides so its foot moves away from the wall at $0.5$ m/s. Find the velocity of the top when the foot is $5$ m from the wall.

questions.title: Cone with equal radius and height
questions.prompt: Water flows at $4\pi\text{ cm}^3$/s into an inverted cone whose radius equals its depth. Find the rate the depth rises when $h=2$ cm.

traps.why: Forgot the ⅓ in the cone volume.

questions.title: Growth constant from a tripling
questions.prompt: A population grows as $N=N_0e^{kt}$ and triples in $10$ years. Find $k$ to four decimal places.

questions.title: Cooling in two equal steps
questions.prompt: An object cools as $T=15+Ae^{-kt}$. It starts at $95^\circ$C and is $55^\circ$C after $10$ minutes. Find $T$ after $20$ minutes.

questions.title: Deflating balloon
questions.prompt: The radius of a spherical balloon decreases at $0.2$ cm/s. Find the rate of change of volume when $r=10$ cm.

questions.title: Moving along a cubic
questions.prompt: A point moves on $y=x^{3}$ with $\dfrac{dx}{dt}=2$. Find $\dfrac{dy}{dt}$ when $x=1$.

questions.title: Water rising in a cylinder
questions.prompt: Water flows into a cylinder of radius $2$ m at $3$ m³/min. How fast is the depth rising?

questions.title: Population halfway to a limit
questions.prompt: A population satisfies $\dfrac{dP}{dt}=-0.2(P-500)$ with $P(0)=100$. Find when $P=300$, to two decimal places.

questions.title: Expanding square of oil
questions.prompt: The side of a square oil slick grows at $0.5$ m/s. How fast is its area increasing when the side is $20$ m?

questions.title: Surface area rate of a sphere
questions.prompt: The radius of a sphere grows at $2$ cm/s. Find the rate of increase of its surface area when $r=5$ cm.

questions.title: Balloon volume rate
questions.prompt: A spherical balloon is inflated at $100$ cm³/s. Find the rate the radius increases when $r=5$ cm.

questions.title: Water draining from a hemisphere
questions.prompt: The volume of water of depth $h$ in a hemispherical bowl of radius $10$ cm is $V=\pi\left(10h^{2}-\tfrac{h^{3}}{3}\right)$. Water leaks at $2$ cm³/s. How fast is the depth falling when $h=5$ cm?
hints: Differentiate V with respect to h.

ladder.nudge: Differentiate V with respect to h.

questions.title: Shadow tip speed
questions.prompt: Using the related-rates set-up where a shadow satisfies $s=\tfrac37x$ for a walker at distance $x$ from a lamp, find how fast the tip of the shadow ($x+s$) moves if the walker moves at $1.4$ m/s.

traps.why: That is the shadow length rate.

questions.title: Rate of change of distance between moving points
questions.prompt: Ship $A$ sails north at $12$ km/h and ship $B$ sails east at $16$ km/h, both from port at noon. How fast are they separating at $2$ pm?

traps.why: Speeds do not add at right angles.

questions.title: Doubling and tripling times
questions.prompt: A population doubles every $5$ years under $P=P_0e^{kt}$. How long to triple, to one decimal place?

questions.title: Rate of change of an angle in a triangle
questions.prompt: In a right triangle with hypotenuse $10$ m, one leg $x$ increases at $0.5$ m/s. Find the rate of change of the angle $\theta$ opposite $x$ when $x=6$.

questions.title: Kite string paying out
questions.prompt: A kite flies at a constant height of $30$ m and moves horizontally away at $4$ m/s. How fast is the string paying out when $50$ m of string is out?

questions.title: Volume rate of a cube from surface area rate
questions.prompt: The surface area of a cube increases at $6$ cm²/s. Find the rate of increase of volume when the side is $4$ cm.

questions.title: Rate of change of a sphere's volume with radius given
questions.prompt: The volume of a sphere grows at $36\pi$ cm³/s. Find $\dfrac{dr}{dt}$ when $r=3$ cm.

questions.title: Rate of change of the area of a triangle with an angle
questions.prompt: A triangle has sides $5$ and $8$ with included angle $\theta$ increasing at $0.1$ rad/s. Find the rate of change of area when $\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{3}$.

questions.title: Two decaying substances equal
questions.prompt: Substance $A$ starts at $100$ g with half-life $2$ h; $B$ starts at $50$ g with half-life $4$ h. When are the masses equal?

questions.title: Newton cooling from a differential equation
questions.prompt: A body cools by $\tfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-20)$. It starts at $90^\circ$C and is $60^\circ$C after $5$ minutes. Find its temperature after $10$ minutes, to one decimal place.

questions.title: Surface area rate of a growing cube
questions.prompt: The volume of a cube increases at $12$ cm$^{3}$/s. Find the rate of increase of its surface area when the side is $2$ cm.

questions.title: Radioactive fraction remaining
questions.prompt: Radium has a half-life of $1600$ years. What fraction of a sample remains after $500$ years, to three decimal places?

questions.title: Estimating time of death by cooling
questions.prompt: A body in a room at $25^\circ$C cools from the normal $37^\circ$C to $34^\circ$C in the first hour after death. Using $T=25+12e^{-kt}$, how long after death is its temperature $30^\circ$C, to two decimal places?

questions.title: Pulling a boat to a dock
questions.prompt: A rope runs from a boat to a pulley $3$ m above the water. The rope is pulled in at $1$ m/s. How fast is the boat approaching the dock when $5$ m of rope is out?

questions.title: Growth to a target population
questions.prompt: A population satisfies $\tfrac{dN}{dt}=0.03N$ with $N(0)=2000$. Find when it reaches $5000$, to two decimal places.

questions.title: Spherical balloon surface area rate
questions.prompt: Air is pumped into a spherical balloon at $100$ cm$^{3}$/s. Find the rate of increase of the surface area when the radius is $10$ cm.

questions.title: Shadow of a pole as the sun sets
questions.prompt: A $10$ m pole casts a shadow of length $s=\dfrac{10}{\tan\theta}$ where $\theta$ is the sun's elevation. If $\theta$ decreases at $0.01$ rad/min, find how fast the shadow lengthens when $\theta=\tfrac\pi4$.

questions.title: Doubling time from a growth constant
questions.prompt: A population grows by $\tfrac{dP}{dt}=0.05P$. Find the doubling time, to one decimal place.

questions.title: Volume of a cube from its surface area rate
questions.prompt: The surface area of a cube grows at $6$ cm$^{2}$/s. Find the rate of change of volume when the side is $4$ cm.

questions.title: Exponential growth from a percentage rate
questions.prompt: A colony grows continuously at $12\%$ per hour: $\tfrac{dN}{dt}=0.12N$. If $N(0)=300$, find $N(5)$ to the nearest whole number.

questions.title: Two decay rates compared
questions.prompt: Isotope A has half-life $3$ days, B has half-life $5$ days. Initially there are equal amounts. After how many days is there twice as much B as A?

questions.title: Rate of change of an angle in a right triangle
questions.prompt: A ladder $10$ m long slides down a wall with its foot moving away at $1$ m/s. Find the rate at which the angle between the ladder and the ground changes when the foot is $6$ m from the wall.

questions.title: Tripling time under exponential growth
questions.prompt: A quantity satisfies $\tfrac{dQ}{dt}=0.1Q$. How long does it take to triple, to two decimal places?

questions.title: Continuous growth at four percent
questions.prompt: An investment of $\$500$ grows by $\tfrac{dA}{dt}=0.04A$. Find its value after $10$ years.

questions.title: Drug concentration falling below a tenth
questions.prompt: A drug concentration satisfies $\dfrac{dC}{dt}=-0.2C$ with $C(0)=50$. How long until it falls to $5$? Give two decimal places.

questions.title: Coffee cooling to forty degrees
questions.prompt: Coffee cools by $\dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-22)$. It is $95^\circ$C at $t=0$ and $70^\circ$C after $4$ minutes. Find how long it takes to reach $40^\circ$C, to one decimal place.

questions.title: Continuous rate doubling money in nine years
questions.prompt: An investment grows by $\dfrac{dA}{dt}=rA$ and doubles in $9$ years. Find $r$ as a percentage to two decimal places.

questions.title: Time to grow 100-fold when tripling every 10 hours
questions.prompt: A culture grows exponentially and triples every $10$ hours. How long does it take to grow by a factor of $100$? Give one decimal place.
